entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Ah, how impressive...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: A stronger Persona has been born from[n]the body and blood of the old. It shall be[n]your new strength.
What do you mean?
This makes no sense at all.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Its worth will be made clearer when you[n]return to the field of battle.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: You better understand it at once! You'll[n]end up dead if you don't master it.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Gather Personas, and bring them here.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Gather a great many, execute them, and[n]continue to give birth to even stronger[n]Personas.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Developing your powers as such will play[n]an integral role in the stand against ruin.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: So that your rehabilitation goes well,[n]we have a variety of rituals to choose[n]in regard to executions.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: And depending on the effort you put in,[n]our master might consider further[n]development of new rituals.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Cry your tears of joy, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Your heart is steadily gaining the strength[n]of rebellion.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems your rehabilitation is proceeding[n]smoothly—a joyous fact, indeed...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: In anticipation of this, I have prepared a[n]gift for you. I hope that you shall accept it.
I feel a deepened connection[n]with Igor...

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: That is a thief's skill, allowing one to[n]tap into their sixth sense and see what[n]is hidden in the dark.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: I believe you can handle it now. May you[n]continue devoting yourself to further[n]rehabilitation.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: ...Now then, if you have any requests,[n]we will heed them.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Forge contracts with as many allies as[n]possible, then deepen those bonds to[n]build upon your powers.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Such encounters await in daily life.[n]Keep your eyes trained; do not neglect[n]the search for others.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Now go. Only a blink of time has passed[n]in your world.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Return here whenever you wish. It shall be[n]of your own accord...
entries.uk: Повертайтеся сюди, коли забажаєте.[n]Це буде з вашої власної волі...
